messages:
Evan: FYI Clara passed a Nimbus Logistics request — they want a private VPC/on-prem deployment with air-gapped option + customer HSM (KMIP). Sales asked for feasibility + a quick SOW.

Clara: Nimbus priority is high. Pilot target: end of Q3. Requirements: no key material leaves their network, Datadog for metrics, strict egress controls. Contact: j.chen@nimbuslogistics.com

Samir: Quick Qs — expected peak concurrent sessions and tokens/sec? Preferred model families? These drive sharding and latency.

Clara: They want multi-turn chat + embeddings. Preference is for a 70B quantized model, but they're okay piloting with a 13B. Peak ~40-60 concurrent users, p50 latency target 300-500ms.

Riley: For on-prem baseline I'd propose 2 x A100 80GB per node or equivalent (we should list NVMe and RAM). K8s 1.25+, kernel 5.15+, 1TB NVMe cache recommended. Also need static egress IPs for callbacks.

Priya: Security checklist: confirm SOC2 status, HSM model/attestation, data classification (any PHI/PCI?), backup policy, and access controls. Also need to know whether they want HSM in their network only.

Clara: They require a customer-managed HSM with KMIP and zero key egress. SOC2 Type II is in progress.

Evan: Proposed owners and due dates:
- Samir (SE): perf preflight + checklist — 3 business days
- Riley (Infra): cluster sizing + ops estimate — 5 business days
- Priya (Security): compliance gating doc — 4 business days
- Legal Bot: DPA/export control scan
I'll draft high-level timeline and go/no-go criteria.

Samir: I'll run a smoke perf with 13B first. Preflight checklist draft:
```
1) Confirm target model binary + quant path
2) RAM & NVMe per shard estimate
3) GPU driver/kernel compatibility
4) Network: outbound ports & allowlist
5) HSM: KMIP endpoints, certs, latency
6) Monitoring: Datadog agent + metrics endpoints
7) Airgap: offline installer bundle size
8) Rollback and health probes
```

Samir: Recommend validating serving stack on 13B quantized build to hit latency before committing to 70B.

Riley: Flag: our installer assumes outbound license check. Need runtime eng to approve offline license bundle or signed license token for airgap installs.

Evan: Launch criteria I'm thinking:
- Preflight passes and perf within 20% of targets
- HSM integration validated with no key egress
- Security gating items closed or risk-accepted
- SOW executed and initial payment received

Legal Bot: Please share org details & data classification. Will run DPA/export-control quick scan. Also flag if they handle regulated data.

Priya: I'll assemble required docs: SOC2 report (or timeline), pen test report, network diagram, HSM attestation, key handling procedures.

Clara: I'll request SOC2 timeline and push for draft SOW. Scheduling technical call with Nimbus infra for next Tue.

Samir: I'll post perf script + run results here when done.

Riley: I'll prototype an offline license bundle and note implementation risk.

Evan: Tentative pilot timeline: 6-10 weeks depending on HSM complexity. If HSM is straightforward and we accept a 13B pilot, could be 4-6 weeks.

Clara: Nimbus agreed to staged rollout (13B pilot then 70B). I'll confirm details on call.

Samir: Action: create reproducible perf steps and attach.

Evan: I'll open a product intake ticket and tag eng-private + eng-runtime. Update thread with blockers. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Ticket created: #IN-4681 (private-nimbus) — linked to product intake.

Clara: Thanks team — I'll finish the intake form and follow up with Nimbus today. :thumbsup:
